dialogues.speaker: Trapeznikov
dialogues.text: Well, I'm mostly known as a bit of a bookworm. I actually spent all my Kristall funds just to get my hands on some research data... If the Rokot hadn't helped me through it, I probably would've been turned into a human icicle by now!

dialogues.speaker: Trapeznikov
dialogues.text: But even after all that, I just can't shake my obsession with Shadow Realm tech. I'm really hoping my curiosity can actually be of some use to everyone here.
